{{Quote|Reading multiple life forms. Two humanoid bipeds, twelve klicks point three-six. Must be our Jedi.''"<br />"''Annihilate them.|A [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] and the T-series tactical droid|<ref name="Paradise Lost" />}}
A '''T-series tactical droid''' served as the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Phorose]]. During the [[Battle of Phorose|battle]] of Phorose, he ordered a squad of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] to search the underground temple constructed by the [[Ru]] for the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]].
